purpose.summary: SOCK08 is a broker/middleware program for web services supporting premium rating, acting as version 2 of SOCK07. It handles socket-based messaging (send/receive buffers), interacts with a Microsoft SQL Server database via ODBC-based embedded SQL, and processes insurance-related contract and rate data (dealer state, contract numbers, effective dates, coverage). It also interfaces with CICS for transaction management.
